title: Case Against Tsu Yun Charged With Propagating Communism

page_data.en:
D. 5650.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REC. .Y.
No. D 5650
Date. 7 / 2 / 34

February 6, 34.

Dear Mr. Sarly,

I forward herewith for your information tabulated
statement relating to the arrest by the Municipal Police
of a communist named Tsu Yun (朱雲) at 10.50 p.m.
January 26, 1934 at No.33 Sung Sing Tong Li, Hochien Road.

The accused appeared on remand before the Second
Branch of the Kiangsu High Court on January 31, 1934 and
was ordered to be handed over to the Chinese authorities.

A quantity of communist literature was seized.

Yours sincerely,

Monsieur R. Sarly,
Chief of the Political Section,
French Police Headquarters.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D Stn. No. 843
Date Judge Kyriac.

Accused Tsu Yun ( ) Age 27. Unemployed.

Charge Application for writ of detention under Arts. 42 and 66 of
S.S.P.
Application is hereby made for the detention of the above
named Chinese who was arrested at 53 Sung Sing Tong Li, Hoochien
Road, at 10.30 p.m. 26/1/34, on suspicion of that he is engaged
in communistic activities, it being suspected that he will ab-
scond.

Proceedings. Mr T.Y.Chang appeared for the Police.
Mr Chang:- At about 10.30.p.m. on the 26/1/34, the accused
in this case was arrested at No.53,Sung Sing Tong Li, off Hoochien
Road, on the authority of a warrant issued by the 1st Special Dist-
rict Court, at the request of the S.P.S.B. when his room was search-
ed a quantity of communistic papers were found. The accused denies
being a communist and stated that the seized property was given to
him by an unknown male chinese who asked him to read the same with
a view of joining the Communist Party. I ask that this case be rem-
anded pending a despatch from the S.P.S.B.
C.D.C.181:- The accused was arrested at No.53,Sung Sing Tong
Li, off Hoochien Road, at the request of the S.P.S.B. When the pol-
ice entered the kitchen the accused was writing on a piece of paper
(produced) which he attempted to destroy.
Accused:- The papers and books are not my property. I met a
male chinese outside the Sang Sing Cotton Mill, who gave me the
seized propertyand asked me to read the same. I did not join the
Communist Party.I admit writing on the paper.
Tsiang Au Wu. Insp. of the S.P.S.B.:- The accused is a member
of the Distributing Dept, of the Communist Party. The informer in
this case is not in court.
DECISION. Remand to 31/1/34. 1.30.P.M. for trial. Accused to be detained in
custody.
G.L.

日期 法官 Kyriac。

被告 朱雲（ ） 年龄 27岁。失业。

指控 根据《上海特别市条例》第42条和第66条申请拘留令。
现申请拘留上述华人，该人于34年1月26日晚上10时30分在霍钦路（Hoochien Road）宋兴通里53号被捕，涉嫌从事共产主义活动，并有潜逃嫌疑。

诉讼过程。 T.Y. Chang 先生代表警方出庭。
Chang 先生：- 34年1月26日晚上10时30分左右，本案被告应上海市公安局的要求，凭第一特别地区法院签发的拘票，在霍钦路旁宋兴通里53号被捕。搜查其房间时，发现大量共产主义文件。被告否认自己是共产党员，并称查获的物品是一名不知名的华籍男子交给他的，该男子让他阅读这些物品以便加入共产党。我请求将此案发回重审，等待上海市公安局的公文。
C.D.C.181：- 被告应上海市公安局的要求，在霍钦路旁宋兴通里53号被捕。当警察进入厨房时，被告正在一张纸上写字（呈堂），他试图销毁这张纸。
被告：- 这些文件和书籍不是我的财产。我在三新棉纺厂（Sang Sing Cotton Mill）外遇到一名华籍男子，他把查获的物品交给我，让我阅读。我没有加入共产党。我承认在纸上写了字。
上海市公安局督察 蒋阿武（Tsiang Au Wu）：- 被告是共产党分发部的成员。本案线人未出庭。
裁决。 发回至34年1月31日下午1时30分受审。被告予以羁押。
G.L.

At 10.50 p.m. 26/1/34, acting under authority
of warrant No. 1190 issued by the S.S.D. Court at
the request of the P.C.B., D.S. Sansom, D.S. Black,
D.S.I. Liu, C.L.C. 161 and members of the P.S.B.
raided a Chinese dwelling house, No. 33 Sung Sing
Tong Li, Hochien Road and arrested a male Chinese
Tsu Yun ( 朱雲 ), in the back downstairs room.
A search of the room revealed documents of a com-
munistic nature.

From there the party proceeded to 15 Yi Tuh Li
( 怡德里 ) Yangtsepoo Road at 11.20 p.m. on auth-
ority of warrant No. 1189. The information in this
case proved to be wrong as the occupant of the room
proved to be one Lee Ah Pau ( 李阿宝 ), native of
Wusih and not Wong Ts Nyoon ( 王芝元 ) of Kompo
as stated in the warrant.

No. 4 Sung Sung Li, Tsu Ka Ba Road was next
visited at 11.30 p.m. under authority of warrant
No. 1188. The occupant of the front upstairs
room there gave his name as Yang Tsung Foo ( 楊書甫 )
and not Yi Lau San ( 奚老三 ) as stated on the
warrant. The tenant of the house stated however
that the man's name was Yi Ding Tsong ( 奚定章 ).
He was identified by an informer of the P.C.B. as
having attended communistic meetings. He was
brought to the Station for further enquiries.
Nothing of an incriminating nature was found in
the room.

34年1月26日晚上10时50分，根据应政治部（P.C.B.）要求由特别地区法院签发的第1190号拘票授权，副巡官 Sansom、副巡官 Black、副巡官督察 Liu、C.L.C. 161 以及上海市公安局（P.S.B.）成员突袭了霍钦路（Hochien Road）宋兴通里33号的一处华人住宅，并在楼下后屋逮捕了一名华籍男子朱雲（ 朱雲 ）。
对该房间的搜查发现了具有共产主义性质的文件。

随后，该队于晚上11时20分凭第1189号拘票授权前往杨树浦路怡德里（Yi Tuh Li ( 怡德里 )）15号。此案中的情报证明有误，因为房间居住者证实为无锡籍的李阿宝（ Lee Ah Pau ( 李阿宝 ) ），而非拘票上所述的宁波籍王芝元（ Wong Ts Nyoon ( 王芝元 ) ）。

接下来于晚上11时30分凭第1188号拘票授权前往曹家渡路（Tsu Ka Ba Road）宋松里4号。那里楼上前屋的居住者自称杨书甫（ Yang Tsung Foo ( 楊書甫 ) ），而非拘票上所述的奚老三（ Yi Lau San ( 奚老三 ) ）。然而，房东称该人名为奚定章（ Yi Ding Tsong ( 奚定章 ) ）。他被政治部的一名线人指认为曾参加共产主义会议。他被带到巡捕房作进一步讯问。在房间内未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。

最后一次突袭是在午夜12点在格伦路（Glen Road）旁的一间草棚进行的，依据第...号拘票授权。

When questioned at the Station the man Tsu Yun denied that he was a member of the communist party but stated that he had been approached by an unknown Chinese male who stated that he (himself) was a member of that party and gave him (Tsu) a number of books and papers, requesting that he peruse them and consider the question of becoming a communist.

The man Yang Ts Foo when questioned stated that he was not a communist but frequented the meetings in order to gain information for 2 Japanese detectives and a Chinese detectives attached to Special Branch, Headquarters, and that one of the Japanese detectives Toong Kyi Tsung Yih (汤浅正一) lived on Woosung Road and gave a telephone number, the latter was called but no person knew of the detective.

The man also had a letter addressed to Inspector Fukumoto, Yangtsepoo Police Station and in view of the fact that the detective could not be located Inspector Fukumoto was called.

Tsu Yun(朱雲), age 27.
Zangchow, Kiangsu.                                B.S. Sansom
Y'Poo Stn.          January 26,1934.              Clerk Z.O.Zung.

    My name is Tsu Yun, age 27, native of Zangchow, residing
at No. 33 Sung Sing Tong Li, Hochien Road, an unemployed food
hawker.    I finished my education at a primary school at my
native home at the age of 18.    I then proceeded to Chinkiang
where I became a medical student at the Sing Ts (尚之)
Hospital, remaining there 4 years.    I afterwards returned to
Zangchow and earned a livelihood by innoculating persons
against various contagious diseases.    I continued working in
this capacity until November 1933 when I came to Shanghai for
the purpose of obtaining employment in a hospital.    I arrived
in Shanghai with $10.00 in my possession and resided in several
lodging houses over a period of about two weeks, after which
I took up residence at the place wherein I was arrested.    My
efforts to obtain suitable employment have so far been
unsuccessful and I am still occupying myself by trying to find
employment, particularly in cotton mills.    About a week ago,
when I was passing the Sung Sing Cotton Mill No. 6, on Ley Rd.
I was approached by a person unknown to me.    I volunteered
the information that I was seeking work and he suggested that
I join the Communist Party.    We arranged to meet again on
Pingliang Road yesterday, January 25, and on keeping this
appointment he gave me the literature found in my possession
at the time of my arrest and ask me to study it.    I have not
had sufficient time to interest myself in any of this literature
and I have not decided to join the Communist Party.    In order
to support myself during the past month I have pawned several
garments which accounts for the pawn receipts found in my
possession.    The person who gave me the literature did

朱云（Tsu Yun），27岁。
江苏常州。                                B.S. Sansom
杨树浦警署          1934年1月26日。              书记员 Z.O.Zung。

    我叫朱云，27岁，常州人，现居霍钦路申新通里33号，是一名失业的食品小贩。    我18岁时在家乡读完小学。    随后前往镇江，成为尚之（Sing Ts）医院的医学生，在那里呆了4年。    之后我回到常州，通过为人们接种各种传染病疫苗谋生。    我一直从事这项工作直到1933年11月，当时我来上海目的是在医院找工作。    我抵达上海时身上仅有10美元，在大约两周的时间里住过几家客栈，之后便搬入我被捕时居住的地方。    我寻找合适工作的努力至今未果，目前仍在忙于找工作，特别是在棉纺厂。    大约一周前，当我路过雷伊路（Ley Rd.）第六申新棉纺厂时，    有一个我不认识的人接近了我。    我主动表示正在找工作，他建议我加入共产党。    我们约定昨天，即1月25日，在平凉路再次见面，赴约时他给了我在我被捕时搜出的那些文献，并让我学习。    我没有足够的时间去研读这些文献中的任何内容，我也尚未决定加入共产党。    为了在过去一个月维持生计，我典当了几件衣物，这解释了在我身上发现的当票。    给我文献的那个人并
